s: Din shiur kezayit ubo b' seipim: kezayit haamur bekol maqom — eno lo qatan velo gadol, ella benoni, vezeh zayit hanniqra "aguri", sheshshamno agur betoko. Veshiuro — yesh omerim shehu kachatzi betza. Veyesh omerim shehu pachot meat mishshelish, lepi mah shennitbaer besiman shs"ch shemmezon shette seudot shel erub shehu y"ch gerogarot yesh bahen keshishsha betzim, im ken haggerogeret hu shelish betza, vehazzayit hu qatan mehaggerogeret. Ulepi sebara harishona, hay"ch gerogarot shel shene seudot shel erub hu yoter mi"ch chatzae betza. Ukebar nitbaer besiman shs"ch vet"t shehaiqqar kehaomerim sheen tzarik yoter mikkeshishsha betzim leerub, lepi shehaerub hu middibre soperim veholekin bo lehaqel. Veim ken bemaror shehu middibre soperim, veken kol dabar shehu middibre soperim sheshshiuro bikzayit — yesh lismok al haomerim shehu pachot meat mishshelish betza. Abal bematztza shehi min hattora, veken kol dabar shehu min hattora — yesh lehachamir kassebara harishona. Abal leinyan beraka acharona ubirkat hammazon sheshshiuro bikzayit — sepeq berakot lehaqel, velo yebarek ad sheyyokal kachatzi betza. Ulekattechilla yesh lizzaher shello lehaknis atzmo lide sepeq beraka, veyokal kachatzi betza o harbeh pachot mishshelish betza bedabar sheen tzarik kezayit. Veken tzarik lizzaher ledaqdeq bishar dabar sheshshiur gadol hu qulla veshiur qatan hu chumra, kegon biur chametz, ayyen siman tm"b vetam"d:

Tzarik lizzaher keshemmeshaer kezayit biraqot sheyyotze bahem yede chobat maror, sheyyemaek haavir shebben ale hayyeraqot vishaer shiur kezayit bayyeraqot atzmam velo baavir shebbenehem. Veken im yesh chalal bammatztza — en hechalal mitztarep likzayit, vetzarik lemaako. (Abal im en chalal bammatztza, apillu hi rakka vaasuya kispog — en tzarik lemaako).
